files.description: Playwright tests for the automations feature: sidebar listing of system vs custom automations, enable/disable toggle, schedule (cron builder) and event trigger editing with validation, Run now (trigger-less warning + enqueued run in Run history), dry-run Test of a custom automation, system automation configuration, AI-assisted custom automation creation (simulated agent), and confirmed deletion.

testContext: The automations utility lives under /utilities/automations (redirects to the first automation by name). The sandbox seeds seven system automations (file_sync, auto_assign_faces, export_photo_tag, assign_location_name, geotag_from_neighbors, classify_labels, duplicate_scan) plus two custom ones: tag-recent-imports (enabled, schedule trigger, published code) and tag-new-arrivals (disabled, media_indexed event trigger, published code AND a working draft, so its editor shows the code toggle and Test button). Sidebar: nav.utilities-sidebar with h2 'Automations'; 'System'/'Custom' h3 headings each followed by ul.panel-nav. Detail page actions (.automation-actions): Enable/Disable toggle (hx-post .../enabled, responds HX-Refresh so the page reloads; label text has surrounding whitespace), 'Run now' (#run-automation-button) or scoped 'Run…' (.js-run-files, shown when ALL triggers are events), 'Edit' link + '#edit-automation-button' + '#delete-automation-button' (custom only), 'Edit triggers' link (all), '#configure-automation-button' (only when the handler declares config fields). Trigger editor (/<slug>/triggers/edit): #automation-triggers fragment re-rendered by a single HTMX endpoint; .js-add-schedule/.js-add-event toggle .adding-schedule/.adding-event on .automation-trigger-add (panels replace the add buttons, so only one is reachable at a time — cancel before opening the other). The cron builder (.cron-mode/.cron-cadence /.cron-raw plain selects) keeps a hidden [name=cron] input and a .cron-preview plain-language description; the Advanced field is validated server-side (debounced 250ms via /utilities/automations/validate-cron) and .js-save-schedule is disabled while invalid (.schedule-editor-error shown). Saved rows: .automation-trigger-row with .automation-trigger-kind, .automation-trigger-desc[data-cron] (friendly text), .automation-trigger-event; row .btn-danger deletes. Run now: a trigger-less automation warns client-side (.notification.visible, 'no triggers') without posting; otherwise POST /<slug>/run returns 202 and the run appears in #automation-runs (.automation-run-row, self-polls every 5s) once the taskq worker records the Job. IMPORTANT: file_sync records NO run Job when the index is already in sync — use tag-recent-imports for run-history assertions. Dry-run Test (editor page): #automation-test-button opens the folder picker (#folder-picker-modal, #folder-picker-select picks the current folder; it starts at the sandbox media dir); POST /<slug>/test-files renders into #automation-test-result — .automation-test-meta lines, 'Actions (N)' heading, one table row per action group (.automation-test-count '× N' and .automation-test-group for repeated actions), details/return value behind the 'Show details' toggle (.automation-test-advanced hidden unless .show-details), .automation-test-error + .is-error on failure. The sandbox has NO AI API key, so agent interactions are simulated client-side: the create test intercepts POST /<slug>/chat (202) and GET /<slug>/status (IN_PROGRESS for two polls at 1.5s apart, then READY), which drives the real chat dialog (#automation-chat-*) and triggers the page reload on settle; grouped/failed dry-run rendering is exercised by fulfilling /test-files with a synthetic payload. Config modal: #configureAutomationModal with #config-<key> inputs (auto_assign_faces: #config-threshold int, #config-assign_multiple_matches bool); saving posts /<slug>/config and redirects to the detail page. Delete uses the global confirm dialog (#global-confirm-dialog, #confirm-dialog-confirm) then submits a hidden form. The 'No automation selected' empty state is unreachable in a seeded environment (the index redirects to the first automation), so it is not asserted. The suite runs serially: it creates one shared custom automation via the #newAutomationModal in the first test (slug captured from the redirect URL) and deletes it in the last; afterAll falls back to POSTing /<slug>/delete.
explanation: Generated manually from specs/automations.yaml after inspecting templates/utilities/automations.html, automations_triggers.html, automations_triggers_edit.html, automations_edit.html, automations_runs.html, utilities/_base.html, routes/utilities/automations.py, static/utilities/automations.js, static/components/cron_builder.js, chat_dialog.js, confirm-dialog.js, folder_picker.js, templates/components/chat_dialog.html and modal.html, background_tasks/automation_config.py, background_tasks/registry.py + tasks/file_sync.py, and yaffo_ui_tests/scripts/seed_database.py. Validated with npm run typecheck and two full green runs (9/9) against the isolated environment (npm run isolatedEnvironment:start, BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5002). Toggle test hardened after an intermittent full-suite failure: each Enable/Disable click now waits for the POST, the flipped label, and the reloaded document's 'load' event before the next click, because htmx re-binds on DOMContentLoaded and an early click hits an unbound button.
